```pseudocode
#| html-line-number: true
#| html-indent-lines: true
\begin{algorithm}
\caption{Kernel ridge regression (average squared loss)}
\begin{algorithmic}
\Require n training pairs, kernel K, penalty λ > 0
\State Construct the Gram matrix G and add nλ to its diagonal to obtain A.
\State Compute the Cholesky factorisation A = LLᵀ.
\State Solve Lu = y by forward substitution.
\State Solve Lᵀα = u by backward substitution.
\State At a new input x, compute the vector of kernels against the training inputs.
\Return Its dot product with α
\end{algorithmic}
\end{algorithm}
```
